entry.title: EQ Artist 1.0.0
entry.summary: EQ Artist by Slow Ops is an 8-band EQ for Akai MPC standalone that you shape two ways, over a live spectrum of the track: drag band nodes on the **PARA** page, or paint the curve you want with a finger on the **DRAW** page. Both pages edit the same EQ, so what you make on one shows on the other. ![The PARA page of EQ Artist Dots on an MPC Live III, with four bands](https://github.com/drj-io/SlowOps.MPC.EQ.Artist/releases/download/v1.0.0/eq-artist-para-page.png) ## Two plugins | Plugin | Curves |
